[COMPLIANCE WITH THIS PUBLICATION IS MANDATORY]

This manual implements Air Force Policy Directive (AFPD) 17-2, Cyberspace Operations, and is consistent with Air Force Instruction (AFI) 36-2651, Air Force Training Program . It establishes procedures and assigns responsibilities for developing, distributing, evaluating and using Air Force (AF) training products for cyber support enlisted specialty qualification training.
